evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/gui/b/a/A extends JFrame, stores LoadoutManager plus one index, and exposes an Apply action plus one JTextField.
Its index-to-label method maps 0..6 exactly to Attack, Range, Strength, Prayer, Defence, Magic and Hitpoints, proving a seven-skill loadout-level editor rather than equipment-slot editing.
R391 LoadoutEquipmentSlotMouseHandler is the only external constructor and opens this editor from fixed panel regions with slot/index 0..6.
The class edits one selected skill-level field and owns no loadout naming, folder, item or spellbook responsibility.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 Loadouts editor identity; no original stripped identifier is claimed.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/gui/b/a/y extends JFrame and owns a name JTextField plus color and icon selectors; exact labels include 'Color:', 'Icon:' and default/color choices.
The reviewed loadout-create button rs/gui/b/a/g opens this dialog with exact title/instruction 'Name Your Loadout' and action text 'Create'.
R391 RenameLoadoutAction opens the same dialog with title 'Rename', seeds existing name/color/icon and installs RenameLoadoutCommitAction.
Because the same editor is used by both creation and renaming, the safe semantic identity is LoadoutMetadataEditorDialog rather than a create-only or rename-only dialog.
